title: The Corner Kick — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The corner kick is hope compressed into an arc
Eleven men moving into the box
With entirely different ideas about where the ball is going to land

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Il set piece è stato praticato martedì [The set piece was practised on Tuesday]
Tutti conoscono la loro corsa [Everyone knows their run]
Tutti conoscono la consegna [Everyone knows the delivery]
Nessuno lo ricorda una volta che la folla inizia [Nobody remembers any of it once the crowd starts]
E il pallone lascia il piede a un angolo leggermente diverso dal previsto [And the ball leaves the boot at a slightly different angle than rehearsed]

[Chorus — English]
The corner says — everyone into the box, near post flick-on
Somewhere between all those instructions the ball arrives
And two very large men jump at the same time

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas liebte den Eckball [Chas loved the corner kick]
Er sagte — es ist der einzige Moment im Fußball [He said — it's the only moment in football]
Wo Chaos offiziell eingeplant ist [Where chaos is officially scheduled]
Wo die Regeln sagen — ja, jetzt, alle rein [Where the rules say — yes, now, everybody go]
Und schau was passiert [And see what happens]

[Verse 3 — English]
The short corner says we want an angle
The crowd came for the chaos — and they didn't get it

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The corner kick
Il calcio d'angolo [The corner kick]
Der Eckball [The corner kick]
That's my boy
